name: VisualTimeAnomaly
description: A benchmark designed to evaluate zero-shot capabilities of multimodal large language models for time series anomaly detection across point-, range-, and variate-wise anomalies including irregular sampling conditions.
reputation: A specialized benchmark that has seen interest in the multimodal/time-series anomaly detection community, but it is still relatively new and niche.
notes: Benchmark covers realistic scenarios with multi-granular anomalies and irregular time series; supports evaluation of multimodal LLMs.
